subject: G-104-012 Week 4 done
body:
Hi team,

G-104-012 came in this morning for Week 4 (Baseline was Tue 8 Sep, so today is Day 31).

- Arrived 07:35. Says last dose was yesterday around 08:30.
- Vitals, ALSFRS-R, C-SSRS, 12-lead ECG, safety labs all done.
- Predose PK drawn 07:50.
- He took his dose in clinic at 08:40, mixed into applesauce with a bit of thickener because he's been coughing on thin liquids. Finished in about 10 min. Ana checked the kit number and his ID before I gave it.
- Postdose PK drawn 13:10, he waited around and had lunch in between.
- Urine pregnancy not applicable (male).
- No CNS-BFS or ALSAQ today, those aren't on the Week 4 list.
- Packet count: returned 2 cartons, all used packets matched 28 doses. New kits dispensed.
- Contraception: wife is post-menopausal, documented again.

Let me know if anything looks off.

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Wk12 call G-107-004
body:
Hello,

Quick update, finished the Week 12 phone call with G-107-004 today. Baseline was 6 Jul. She'd been away visiting family so we couldn't catch her earlier in the week.

Compliance check-in by phone, she says no missed doses. Reminded her to bring all packets to Week 16. Con meds unchanged. AEs: mild constipation, ongoing, already logged. Contraception reviewed (IUD + partner uses condoms), no change.

Thanks
Marco

subject: G-102-019 wk8
body:
Hi all,

G-102-019 Week 8 visit today (Day 57). Everything on the list done: vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, CNS-BFS, ECG, labs, C-SSRS, biomarker blood and urine. She took her dose at home at 7, postdose PK drawn at 10:20.

Urine hCG negative. For contraception she's still on her birth control pill (Lo Loestrin) and they use condoms every time, so two methods. Documented in the CRF.

Dispensed 4 cartons.

Thanks,
Jess

subject: Week 16 - G-111-006 + sperm bank question
body:
Hi team,

G-111-006 Week 16 in clinic today, Day 114 from his 15 Jun Baseline.

Order: PGI-C and PGI-S first, then ALSAQ-40, ROADS, CNS-BFS, ALSFRS-R, SVC, strength, vitals, ECG, labs, biomarker blood/urine, C-SSRS. Dr. Lee did CGI-C at the end. He took his dose at home at 6:30 am, PK drawn 09:45.

Contraception: his girlfriend is on the combined pill and he uses condoms. Re-documented.

He asked if he can bank sperm at a clinic "just in case" before he gets worse. I told him he can't donate sperm while on study drug or for 90 days after his last dose. He was fine with that. Also, he'll stay on his famotidine.

Thanks,
Leah

subject: G-105-021 week 2 call - doubled up
body:
Hi,

Did the Week 2 call with G-105-021 today (Day 15). Mostly fine, but he told me he forgot his dose on Saturday (26th) and on Sunday morning he took 4 packets to "catch up." No symptoms at all, he feels normal.

I told him not to do that again: if he forgets, take it the same day, otherwise just skip to the next day. Noted it on the compliance log. Con meds and AEs reviewed, nothing new. Wife has an IUD and he uses condoms, unchanged.

Rachel

subject: Pharmacy temp log - weekend
body:

Everything looks normal and the stick packs aren't damaged, so we went ahead and dispensed the DNL343 kits for this morning's visits (G-103-008 and G-103-014). Logged the excursion in our pharmacy binder.

Tom
Research Pharmacy

subject: G-108-002 Wk24 + LP
body:
Hi team,

G-108-002 Week 24 was Tuesday 10 Nov (Baseline 26 May, so Day 168). All assessments done, PK pre and post, endocrine labs, and he took his first ATE dose in clinic. He's in the extension now.

His optional LP couldn't fit on Tuesday, so neuro did it this morning (Fri 13 Nov). Both CSF tubes (biomarker and PK) sent. He had his baseline LP too, so we have pairs. He's been dosing at home since Wednesday, no issues.

Thanks,
Kim

subject: New rando G-101-030 - meds
body:
Hi all,

G-101-030 had Baseline yesterday (Thu 10 Sep) and took first dose in clinic. One thing from the med review: she'd been taking St. John's wort for mood and stopped it on 1 Sep when we told her it wasn't allowed. Half-life is about a day and a half so it should be long gone.

She also takes famotidine 20 mg at night for reflux and a daily multivitamin, both continuing.

Thanks,
Dana

subject: G-106-011 Week 8 by video
body:
Hi team,

G-106-011 fell last week and broke her wrist, and she can't manage the 2-hour drive right now, so Dr. Patel approved doing Week 8 by telemedicine today (Thu 1 Oct, Day 52; Baseline 10 Aug).

Done on video: ALSFRS-R, CNS-BFS, con meds, AEs (the fall and fracture are logged), C-SSRS, contraception review (bilateral tubal ligation 2019, partner uses condoms). Compliance check by video. No ECG, labs or PK since she wasn't in clinic, documented as missed per the MOP. Next kit shipped per MOP.

Thanks,
Omar

subject: Wk 4 G-109-003 - came in late
body:
Hi,

G-109-003 Week 4 today (Day 29). Transport was late so she didn't get here until 11:15, and she'd already taken her dose at home at 7:30 because she didn't want to go without. Couldn't do a predose sample obviously, so we drew one postdose PK at 11:40 and she left after the rest of the visit, around 12:30.

Rest of visit fine: vitals, ALSFRS-R, ECG, labs, C-SSRS, urine hCG neg, contraception (IUD + condoms). Dispensed.

Sam

subject: G-110-015 week 8 PK
body:
Hi everyone,

Week 8 for G-110-015 today (Fri 16 Oct, Day 53). He held his dose so we gave it here at 09:05 with yogurt. We had a tight lab courier pickup so the postdose PK was drawn at 09:45 and made the 10:00 pickup.

ECG, vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, CNS-BFS, labs, biomarker blood and urine, C-SSRS all done. Wife postmenopausal. Kits dispensed.

Thanks,
Nadia

subject: AE - rash G-104-017, drug held
body:
Hi all,

G-104-017 (Baseline 17 Aug) called Monday about an itchy rash on her chest and arms that started Saturday. Dr. Gomez saw her in clinic today and graded it moderate (Grade 2), possibly related. AE entered in EDC.

Dr. Gomez called the medical monitor this morning and they agreed to hold study drug starting today, with a plan to restart at the full dose within about 2 weeks if it settles. Blind kept. She's on a topical steroid and antihistamine (added to con meds).

We didn't draw anything extra since it wasn't a scheduled visit. Next scheduled is Week 12 phone on the 9th of November.

Thanks,
Ellie

body:

Gabe

subject: G-113-007 week 2
body:
Hi,

Week 2 phone call with G-113-007 today (Thu 15 Oct, Day 17 from Baseline 28 Sep). Her husband gives the drug through her G-tube, mixed in water, usually around 8am. Ines

subject: ET visit G-102-009
body:

Follow-up safety call is booked for Fri 23 Oct.

Thanks,
Mia

subject: Baseline G-114-002 done
body:
Hello team,

G-114-002 randomized and had Baseline today, Wed 21 Oct. Master screening was 10 Sep and we did the regimen screening together with baseline today.

- Her optional baseline LP was done on 9 Oct, right after eligibility was confirmed, to fit the neuro schedule. Biomarker tubes only, no CSF PK.
- ALSAQ-40, CNS-BFS, ROADS, PGI-S, vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, strength, labs, endocrine labs (drawn 09:40), urine hCG negative, C-SSRS done.
- She was getting tired, so we gave her first dose at 11:00 and then did the ECG at 11:20 before she left.
- DNA sample tube clotted, we'll redraw at Week 4.
- Contraception: hormonal IUD (Mirena) + partner uses condoms.

Thanks,
Ravi

subject: Wk 24 / ATE start - G-115-010
body:

Thanks,
Josh

subject: Monitoring note - G-116-005 ATE entry
body:
Hi team,

Notes from my remote review of G-116-005 (Baseline 25 Mar, Week 24 on Tue 15 Sep):

1. She'd been on one packet a day since July after a dose reduction for nausea. At Week 24 she was started in the ATE on one packet (100 mg) "to keep things the same". I can't find any note of a discussion with the medical monitor about this.
2. ATE Week 2 call was done Wed 23 Sep. The calendar shows it booked as "Week 26 from baseline".
3. Contraception: she has Essure coils (placed 2015) and her husband uses condoms. Documented at each visit.
4. Con meds: rosuvastatin 10 mg, long-standing, no issues noted.

Please reply with corrections or notes to file.

Thanks,
Hannah (CRA)
